compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3: validator accepts a conforming Copy Needs section
- dd-4: validator rejects malformed Copy Needs sections (missing required field or unknown page identifier)

## Description
Implement `plugins/dso/scripts/check-copy-needs-schema.sh`. The validator accepts a file path argument, locates the `## Copy Needs` section, parses per-item entries using grep/awk, verifies each item carries all required fields (stable_id, type, location, page, validation_rule), verifies the `page` value is a member of the controlled vocabulary defined in the contract doc (task-1), exits 0 on conformance and non-zero with a diagnostic message on failure. Set executable bit. Implementation must satisfy the RED tests from task-2.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Validator script exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/check-copy-needs-schema.sh
- [ ] Validator accepts the passing fixture
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-copy-needs-schema.sh plugins/dso/tests/scripts/fixtures/copy-needs-pass.md
- [ ] Validator rejects the missing-field fixture
  Verify: ! bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-copy-needs-schema.sh plugins/dso/tests/scripts/fixtures/copy-needs-fail-missing-field.md
- [ ] Validator rejects the unknown-page fixture
  Verify: ! bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-copy-needs-schema.sh plugins/dso/tests/scripts/fixtures/copy-needs-fail-unknown-page.md
- [ ] ShellCheck passes on the validator
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/check-copy-needs-schema.sh
- [ ] Full RED test from task-2 now passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test-check-copy-needs-schema.sh

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-copy-needs-schema.sh: Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On failures: escalate to opus, then user
